name: reasoning-message-wrong-role-fatal
description: REASONING_MESSAGE_START carrying role 'assistant' is fatal: the schema pins the role to 'reasoning', so any other value is a malformed known value rather than an unrecognised member
kill: widen REASONING_MESSAGE_START's role from the fixed 'reasoning' to any string, or coerce a wrong role back to 'reasoning'

dotnet.intentional: GAP, not a design difference: the .NET model types REASONING_MESSAGE_START.role as an open string rather than the literal the schema pins, so a wrong role is carried rather than rejected and the run completes. Alignment tracked separately.
